items.text: Double-quote any label with structural characters — the 'no quotes' note is refuted by a parse-level proof on the live pinned version.
items.title: D2 Mermaid labels

items.title: D4 Probe targets

items.text: Three enumerations (workspace_id scan + FK walk + string-keyed via slug map); exporter keys on workspace_id; completeness = information_schema + pg_constraint diff + count parity; NULL-dataset premise refuted, drifted-string vector is the real threat.
items.title: D5+D6 Keystone constraints

items.text: Router plug after ResolveWorkspace is the only gate covering content AND media; telemetry span is the free meter; registry.ex is pattern-only prior art.
items.title: D7 Quota seam

items.text: REFUTED as stated — no CDN, private cache-control on reads, ETag after the query, purge hits the consumer cache; media is the one cacheable family.
items.title: D8 Edge cache

items.text: The honest metric is dump+restore cutover downtime — replication does not exist anywhere.
